reasons_for_inclusion: PKD's most systematic metaphysical statement, the fullest working-out of the 2-3-74 model.
Essential primary text for understanding the Urgrund, demiurge, Zebra, anamnesis, and the theophany cluster.
Demonstrates both the depth of PKD's philosophical engagement and the limits of his own reasoning.
editorial_angle: Present as the portal's authoritative statement of PKD's own cosmological model. Highlight the essay's syncretic erudition and its honest impasses. Link closely to 'How to Build a Universe' (same year, overlapping material) and to the Exegesis entries.
curator_notes: Featured: this is load-bearing for three of the four standing research questions. The essay's systematic ambition and explicit uncertainty make it ideal for a knowledge portal. Frame the reversals and admissions of ignorance as intellectual honesty, not failure.
